name: TruInspect
description: Mobile vehicle inspection and trade-in appraisal tool for car dealerships. Guides inspectors through a 27-slot photo walk-around, records per-point condition, manual damage tagging, a disclosure checklist, and printable PDF VIR reports. Trade-in workflow values vehicles against live market prices and produces signed offers. Damage grading is computed from real inspector inputs, not black-box AI.
